summary: Frontend-only smoke testing of 4 new features (Squad Chat, Route Playback, Streak Tracker, Weather Hero) via Chromium mobile viewport (390x844) against https://outdoor-command.preview.emergentagent.com. All 4 features work end-to-end with correct testIDs, correct seed data, correct state updates, and no console errors. No page errors captured. No fixes needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Route playback timer visually advances very fast (0:00 -> ~18:22 in ~3.5s) because the 42:00 story duration is compressed into an 8s animation. This is intentional demo behavior per code (duration = max(1500, 8000*remaining) in route-playback/[id].tsx:258). Not a bug, but the elapsed number appears to 'race' — main agent may want to pace it more realistically (e.g., cap displayed elapsed rate) if that's the design intent.

In mission/[id].tsx the KeyboardAvoidingView uses keyboardVerticalOffset={insets.top} which is unusual — typically bottom offset is 0 and top is not the correct offset for a bottom composer. Web preview still respects safe-area bottom padding via paddingBottom: insets.bottom + spacing.md (correct). Consider verifying on real iOS device.
seed_data_creation: None. Used built-in mock seed data (SEED_CHATS for m-northside, SEED_USER_STORIES for stories, TOMORROW_WEATHER, INITIAL_MISSIONS).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All feature testIDs confirmed present and functional in web preview: home-streak-card, streak-day-0..6 (7 pills), home-weather-strip (with Sunrise/Sunset/High-Low/Wind chips), chat-photo-button, chat-cheer-button, chat-input, chat-send-button, story-play-<storyId> (s1,s2,s3), playback-play-button, playback-reset-button. State store is React Context (in-memory) — reload resets. Streak count is derived, seeded to include today + several prior days. Route generation is deterministic per story id via generateRoute() in src/utils/route.ts.
